A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 5 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 604 identities would post 1746 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
